questions.question: What fundamental contradiction does the narrator working at the hotel experience?
answers: He has too much free time
He serves the luxury sold to guests while knowing about the hidden failures and the poor realities of the work
He doesn't want to work at night because he likes mornings
He doesn't understand the hotel rules
questions.explanation: The contrast between the price of the suites and the working conditions and quality of service is the axis of the text.

questions.question: Why is the conversation with the mysterious man on the terrace a turning point?
answers: Because he gets a promotion offer
Because he hears from the designer that the hotel's problems were known and hidden from the very beginning
Because he meets a new VIP guest
Because he finds a lost phone
questions.explanation: The man reveals that the system had been faulty from the start and that someone knew about it.

questions.question: What does the narrator already know before the man names it directly?
answers: That the hotel will be sold within a month
That the internal emails confirmed that technical warnings were being ignored
That the media made everything up
That the air conditioning is perfect
questions.explanation: He had seen the technicians' notes that ended up in the bin.

questions.question: What decision does the narrator make after returning from the terrace?
answers: He decides to delete all the emails
He writes a letter and contacts someone who can publish the true story
He leaves right away before dawn without a trace
He asks for a raise
questions.explanation: The climax is the letter to the management and the phone call asking for the truth to be published.

questions.question: What does the epilogue with the trip to Japan mean?
answers: That the hotel is a great success
That the narrator regains his agency and closes the chapter of a life based on pretending
That he returns to the same job after the renovation
That he wants to design air conditioning
questions.explanation: The departure symbolises leaving a toxic arrangement and the beginning of a new chapter.
